q: Acquire the Spirit of peace, and then thousands around you will be saved.
Keep your mind in hell, and despair not.
He who does not have humility does not have love, and he who does not have love does not have God.
If you are a theologian, you will pray truly; and if you pray truly, you are a theologian.
Man is a creature commanded to become god.
Glory to God for all things.
Slander no one, and do not say: this one lives loosely. That is not confession, it is accusation.
Nothing is stronger than one who gives thanks.
God became man so that man might become god.
Flee, be silent, be still. These are the roots of a sinless life.
I have often repented of having spoken, but never of having kept silent.
Do not be afraid of the darkness of the coming night; be afraid of the darkness in your own heart.
I saw the snares that the enemy spreads out over the world, and I said groaning: what can get through such snares? Then I heard a voice saying: humility.
Expect temptation until your last breath.
Where there is no humility, there all is in vain.
A man who lives with a brother must be like a stone pillar: reviled, he is not angry; praised, he is not proud.
Do not give your heart to that which does not satisfy the heart.
This life has been given you for repentance; do not waste it on other things.
A merciful heart burns with love for the whole creation — for men, for birds, for beasts, even for demons.
Love sinners, but hate their deeds.
Repentance is the renewal of baptism, a contract with God for a second life.
If you have not yet learned to weep, weep for your own hardness.
He who has not measured himself will never measure others rightly.
Do not say that God is just; His justice is not known in your dealings.
Christ is risen — my joy!
Joy is not in things; it is in us.
Pray simply. Do not expect to find in your heart anything remarkable.
We must not be downcast when we fall; we must rise at once and go on.
Live simply, and God will not abandon you.
Prayer is the breath of the soul; as breathing is to the body, so prayer is to the spirit.
Stand before God with the mind in the heart, and go on standing before Him day and night until the end of life.
Prayer is the test of everything; where prayer goes well, everything goes well.
Do not despair over your falls; God's mercy is greater than your weakness.
Prayer without attention is like a body without a soul.
Prayer is the raising of the mind and heart to God.
Where there is simplicity there are no wiles; where there are wiles there is no love.
Bear with the failings of others as you wish yours to be borne.
If you cannot carry your neighbour's burden, at least do not add to it.
Love has no calculation in it; where calculation begins, love ends.
Christ gave us not a system of thought but Himself.
Christ is our closest relative; He gave us His own blood.
When we do something with love, God does not look at the result but at the love.
He who has Christ within cannot be afraid of anything.
Do not fight to expel the darkness from the chamber of your soul. Open a tiny aperture for the light, and the darkness will disappear.
Whatever you do, do it with love, and Christ will be in it.
Love Christ, and let nothing else concern you.
Obedience gives rest; self-will gives torment.
The greatest disease of our age is loneliness of soul; only Christ heals it.
Patience is a tree with bitter roots and very sweet fruit.
Seek God daily, but seek Him in your heart and not outside it.
Thank God for everything; illness has taught me more than health ever did.
Read the lives of the saints, and you will see how far we are from Christian life.
Learning enlightens; but the fear of God enlightens more.
Be like the bee, which gathers only honey from every flower.
Only what is done for God remains.
In the last times people will be saved by love, humility and kindness.
Do not judge, and you will be at peace with everyone.
Suffering is not to be explained but to be borne with Christ.
I love everyone equally, and so I can refuse no one.
It is later than we think; hasten therefore to do the work of God.
One must have compassion, and one must be free of the spirit of this age.
God is not the object of thought but the subject of communion.
Forgive, and you will already be halfway to heaven.
The whole world is a book, and every creature in it a word about God.
